title: Seoul City Tour Bus & Hop-On Hop-Off (Tiger Bus) 2026: Route Map, Timetable, Prices, Night Tour
description: Seoul hop-on hop-off bus (Seoul City Tour Bus / Tiger Bus) guide, updated November 2026: the 15-stop route map from Gwanghwamun, timetable every 25 min from 09:20 to 16:50, ticket prices from KRW 27,000, the Han River night tour and Monday closures.
h1Sub: Hop-on hop-off route map, timetable, prices and night tour
lead: The Seoul City Tour Bus (run by Tiger Bus) has left from Gwanghwamun since 2000. By day it loops past Gyeongbokgung Palace, Myeong-dong and N Seoul Tower on a hop-on hop-off course; at night a 90-minute tour crosses the Han River bridges and stops at Namsan.

summary: Gwanghwamun ticket office, 100 m from Gwanghwamun Station (Line 5) exit 6
Downtown, Palaces & Namsan · 15 stops · departures 09:20–16:50 every 25 min · about 1 h 30 min per loop
Han River & Namsan · 19:00 (19:30 May–Aug) · about 90 min
Day from KRW 27,000 (adult) / KRW 19,000 (child) · Night from KRW 25,000 / KRW 16,000
Every Monday (if Monday is a public holiday it runs and closes Tuesday)

routes.name: Downtown, Palaces & Namsan course
stops: Gyeongbokgung Palace / National Folk Museum / MMCA
routes.tip: The ticket is valid for that day only, and you can get on and off at the 15 stops as often as you like. The last bus leaves Gwanghwamun at 16:50 and returns at 18:20, so check the time before getting off at N Seoul Tower or Dongdaemun.

night.time: 19:00 once a day (19:30 from 1 May to 31 Aug)
night.start: Gwanghwamun ticket office (boarding from 40 min before)
night.duration: about 90 min (about 25 min stop at N Seoul Tower)
night.price: Adult from KRW 25,000 · child from KRW 16,000
night.text: The night course leaves Gwanghwamun, crosses Mapo, Hangang, Dongjak, Banpo, Seongsu and Hannam bridges, stops at N Seoul Tower for about 25 minutes and ends at Cheonggye Plaza via Sungnyemun. N Seoul Tower is its only stop.

priceNote: Prices are the discounted (from) and list prices shown on the official site on 28 October 2026. Children are 48 months to high-school age. Prices change by date, so check the final amount when booking.
howToBook: Open the official site with the button below and choose a course.
Pick the date and number of people and pay. Online booking closes the day before you ride.
To ride the same day, buy a ticket at the Gwanghwamun ticket office without booking.
howToRide: Walk 100 m from Gwanghwamun Station (Line 5) exit 6, or about 300 m from City Hall Station (Lines 1 and 2) exit 3, to the Gwanghwamun ticket office.
Give the name on your booking at the ticket office and collect your boarding pass.
Show the pass to the driver when you board. Seats are first come, first served.
The audio guide is available in 12 languages; ask at the ticket office if you need earphones.
Get off at any of the 15 stops and catch the next bus, which comes every 25 minutes.

faq.q: Is there a hop-on hop-off bus in Seoul?
faq.a: Yes. The Seoul City Tour Bus (Tiger Bus) is Seoul's hop-on hop-off bus: one day ticket covers unlimited rides at 15 stops from Gwanghwamun, every 25 minutes from 09:20 to 16:50, Tuesday to Sunday.

faq.q: Is the Tiger Bus the same as the Seoul City Tour Bus?
faq.a: Yes. Tiger Bus is the brand name of the Seoul City Tour Bus that leaves from Gwanghwamun.

faq.q: Can I ride the Seoul City Tour Bus without booking?
faq.a: Yes. Same-day tickets cannot be bought online; buy them at the Gwanghwamun ticket office. For the night course it is worth calling 02-777-6090 to check seats first.

faq.q: Where do I board the Seoul City Tour Bus?
faq.a: At the Gwanghwamun ticket office, 100 m from Gwanghwamun Station (Line 5) exit 6 and about 300 m from City Hall Station exit 3.
No, it is closed every Monday. If Monday is a public holiday it runs and closes on Tuesday instead.

faq.q: Is there an English audio guide?
faq.a: Yes. The day course has an audio guide in 12 languages, including English.

faq.q: Can I choose an open-top double-decker?
faq.a: No. The bus type (open-top double-decker, glass-top double-decker or single-deck) is assigned on the day.

topics.h3: Seoul hop-on hop-off bus route map
topics.a: The day course is a 15-stop loop that starts and ends at Gwanghwamun: Myeong-dong, Namsangol Hanok Village, N Seoul Tower, DDP and Dongdaemun Market, Changgyeonggung and Changdeokgung palaces, Insadong and Bukchon, Cheong Wa Dae and Gyeongbokgung Palace. The map on this page numbers every stop in order.
topics.label: See the route and map

topics.a: Buses leave Gwanghwamun every 25 minutes from 09:20 to 16:50, and a full loop takes about 1 hour 30 minutes. The last bus is back at Gwanghwamun around 18:20, so after about 16:00 check the time before you get off far from the start, for example at N Seoul Tower.
topics.label: See the route and map

topics.h3: Seoul City Tour Bus ticket price
topics.a: The day course costs from KRW 27,000 for adults (KRW 36,000 list) and from KRW 19,000 for children; the night course costs from KRW 25,000 for adults and from KRW 16,000 for children. Children are 48 months to high-school age, and prices change by date.
topics.label: See prices

topics.h3: Seoul City Tour Bus Gwanghwamun ticket office
topics.a: Everyone boards at the Gwanghwamun ticket office, 100 m from Gwanghwamun Station (Line 5) exit 6 or about 300 m from City Hall Station exit 3. Collect your boarding pass there with the name on your booking, or buy a same-day ticket.
topics.label: See where to board

topics.a: The Han River & Namsan night course leaves Gwanghwamun at 19:00 (19:30 from May to August), crosses six Han River bridges and stops about 25 minutes at N Seoul Tower. It takes about 90 minutes and runs once a night.
topics.label: See the night tour

topics.h3: Tiger Bus vs Yellow Balloon city bus
topics.a: Tiger Bus is the brand of the Seoul City Tour Bus that leaves Gwanghwamun, which is the bus this page covers. Yellow Balloon is a separate company with its own routes and tickets, so a ticket for one cannot be used on the other.
topics.label: See the summary

topics.h3: Discover Seoul Pass and the Seoul City Tour Bus
topics.a: Discover Seoul Pass sellers list the Seoul City Tour Bus among the pass attractions, usually as one ride. What is included depends on the pass type, so check the pass's own list before relying on it; otherwise buy at the Gwanghwamun ticket office or on the official site.
topics.label: See how to book

topics.h3: Can you buy Seoul hop-on hop-off tickets on the bus?
topics.a: Plan to buy at the Gwanghwamun ticket office: you show your boarding pass to the driver when you board. Online booking closes the day before, so for a same-day ride go to the ticket office.
topics.label: See how to book

topics.h3: Is the Seoul City Tour Bus worth it?
topics.a: It is worth it if you want palaces, Myeong-dong and N Seoul Tower in one day without working out subway transfers, especially with the English audio guide. With a bus every 25 minutes and a last departure at 16:50, plan on three or four stops, and avoid Mondays when it does not run.
